newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU mergers and takeovers - updated August 6.
newsitem.headline: EU mergers and takeovers - updated August 6.

text.p: Following are additions and deletions to the list of takeovers, mergers and joint ventures being reviewed by the European Commission under the EU's merger regulation (*). The Commission has a month to clear or start a detailed, four-month probe after a deal has been filed.
ADDITIONS
None
DELETIONS
-- VIAG's Kloeckner Stahl und Metallhandel GmbH's proposed acquisition of control of steel distributor ODS Hoogovens Handel BV (Notified July 2)
ONGOING ONE-MONTH REVIEWS

-- Proposal by Deutsche Lufthansa AG's Lufthansa CityLine GmbH and Bombardier Inc's Dutch Bombardier International NV to acquire joint control of European Business Jet Services GmbH (Notified July 23)
-- Plans by VIAG group's Kloeckner Stahl und Metallhandel GmbH to acquire control of Comercial de Laminados S.A. (Notified July 22)
-- Proposal by STET's Stet International Netherlands, Spain's Union Fenosa Inversiones and Grupo Electrico de Telecommunicaciones, part of the Endesa group, to acquire joint control of Retevision
Notified July 15)
-- Proposed joint venture between Philips Electronics NV and Lucent Technologies Inc of the United States in the consumer telephones market (Notified July 14)
-- Plans by computer firms Compaq and Tandem to merge (Notified July 10)
-- Proposal by Stinnes AG's RS Partnership and Haniel Reederei Holding GmbH to share control of Belgian shipping company De Grave NV (Notified July 9)
-- Plans by German unit of ADM International Ltd, subsidiary of U.S. Archer Daniels Midland, and British Acatos & Hutcheson Plc to acquire joint control of Soya Mainz GmbH & Co (Notified July 8)
-- Certain aspects of proposed joint venture between Thyssen Stahl AG and Krupp Hoesch Stahl, including production of steel tubes. (Notified July 7)
-- Proposal by Norsk Alcoa A/S, controlled by Aluminium Company of America, and Elkem ASA to acquire joint control of Elkem Aluminium ANS (Notified July 4)
-- VEBA AG's proposed acquisition of 36.4 percent stake in Degussa AG (Notified July 2)
DETAILED REVIEWS
-- Siemens AG's proposed takeover of Swiss company Elektrowatt AG (Full probe opened July 29)
-- Proposed merger between Guinness Plc and Grand Metropolitan Plc (Full probe opened June 20)
-- Proposed Nordic soft drinks joint venture of Coca-Cola and Carlsberg A/S of Denmark. (Full probe opened May 2)

(*) Commission has exclusive EU competence in corporate concentrations involving firms with a combined global turnover of five billion ecus and EU turnover of 250 million ecus each. It has the power to block, or force changes to, deals which create or strengthen dominant positions in the EU whether or not the companies involved are European.
